name: Mean distance between failures (car-miles)
definition: Car-miles run per failure. Each agency defines a countable failure differently (for example a failure causing a delay of 5 minutes or more). Record the agency's definition in each row.

name: Mean distance between failures (car-km)
definition: Car-km run per failure, as mdbf_car_miles. Converted rows are derived.

name: Mean kilometres between failures (train-km)
definition: Train-km run per failure causing a delay over a threshold (for example Singapore LTA: delays over 5 minutes). Multiply by cars per train to compare with car-km measures.

name: Terminal on-time performance
definition: Share of trains arriving at their terminal on time, by the agency's tolerance. NYC changed the definition over time.

name: Wait assessment
definition: Share of intervals between trains that are within a tolerance of the scheduled interval (NYC: scheduled headway plus 25 percent).

name: Service delivered
definition: Share of scheduled trains (or train-km) actually run, at the peak or all day, as defined by the agency.

name: Passenger journeys on time
definition: Share of passenger journeys not delayed beyond a threshold (Hong Kong MTR: 5 minutes).

name: Major delays
definition: Number of incidents causing a delay over a long threshold (Hong Kong MTR: 31 minutes or more, attributable to the company). Count per year.

name: Lost customer hours
definition: London Underground: total extra time passengers spend because of service disruptions, weighted.

name: Excess journey time
definition: London Underground: average extra time per journey compared with the scheduled journey.

name: Demand-weighted journey time
definition: London Underground: demand-weighted average journey time including perceived penalties for waiting and crowding.

name: Contract punctuality indicator
definition: Paris (IDFM/RATP): line-level punctuality indicator against a contract reference. Peak periods measured as share of planned train-km produced; off-peak as share of passengers who wait less than the promised interval.

name: Train punctuality
definition: Share of trains (or train trips) arriving within the agency's lateness threshold at the end of the line or at stations. Thresholds differ (Singapore LTA: within 2 minutes at the terminal or turnaround).

name: Delays over 30 minutes
definition: Number of incidents in the period that delayed service by more than 30 minutes, as counted by the agency.

name: Delays over 30 minutes per million train-km
definition: Incidents delaying service by more than 30 minutes, divided by train-km in millions (as compiled by Singapore LTA for Japanese metros, from Japanese government statistics).

name: Car-miles used for MDBF
definition: Car-miles in the numerator of an agency's MDBF figure. Input row for derived MDBF values.

name: Failures used for MDBF
definition: Failure count in the denominator of an agency's MDBF figure. Input row for derived MDBF values.

name: On-time trips
definition: Trips counted as on time in an agency's on-time performance figure. Input row for derived OTP values.

name: Scheduled trips
definition: Scheduled trips in the denominator of an agency's on-time performance figure. Input row for derived OTP values.
